calibration.rule: planned EXTREE nodes = round-152 search nodes x the aggregate ratio; the maximum observed ratio is used for the pessimistic column

margins.meaning: largest_still_safe is the biggest capacity value this cell could turn out to have with every exposed row still strictly closed.  A generated certificate reporting more than that refutes the plan for this cell and the row optimisation has to be redone with the true value.

generation_plan.rule: cheapest first, so that a wrong planned value shows up early; each checkpoint states in advance how many of the 180 exposed rows must be closed by then
